propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook lacks the prod instance ID and region needed for operators to start SSM sessions, forcing them to guess
The prod instance ID (i-00880b2c7f13527c5) and region (us-east-1) are defined in terraform and ADR-0026 but not in the operational runbook
The runbook must document which AWS region (sourced from var.aws_region default and versions.tf backend) and account (896586841071) operators should use for SSM operations
The autodeploy.sh script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync, but script-only changes require manual deploy because they don't trigger a deploy event

The installer script and systemd unit files (install-autodeploy.sh, rebar-autodeploy.service/timer) are excluded from in-run re-materialization to avoid self-modification races and always require hand-deploy
